title: FeatureArc: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Evolving Features
title_zh: FeatureArc：在演化功能上对编码智能体进行基准测试

paragraphs.en: A software feature usually evolves over time: developers extend its first version as new use cases and requirements arrive, and each extension builds on code written earlier. Most feature benchmarks evaluate a single request on a fixed codebase. Feature evolution requires evaluating successive extensions on an agent’s own earlier code and checking whether the feature remains correct. We introduce FeatureArc to evaluate coding agents on evolving features, together with a pipeline that constructs its tasks from repository histories. The benchmark combines dependencies between successive stages of the same feature, explicit requirements and interface contracts, and executable checks across four programming languages. The pipeline validates fail-to-pass (F2P) tests for new behavior and pass-to-pass (P2P) tests for existing behavior on the reference code before and after each stage. We evaluated 10 coding agents on 73 manually reviewed tasks of 2 to 10 stages. Each agent works in one persistent session and workspace without external test feedback or rollback. The evaluation reveals a gap between first-stage and whole-feature success: pooled success falls from 62.7% at the first stage to 28.5% when the whole feature is tested on the final code. Trajectory analysis identifies inherited defects as a common failure mechanism, present in 72.9% of failed later stages. These earlier errors often remain undetected: in stages following a failure, agents leave the earlier error unnoticed about 95% of the time, and their self-tests rarely revisit earlier stages. Evolving a feature autonomously, without human checks between stages, therefore remains a substantial challenge for current coding agents. At Tencent, the pipeline extends internal evaluations to this setting and guides the development of Hunyuan, Tencent’s family of large language models.
paragraphs.zh: 软件功能通常会随时间演化：随着新的用例和需求出现，开发者会扩展其首个版本，而每次扩展都建立在先前编写的代码之上。 大多数功能基准测试是在固定的代码库上评估单个请求。 功能演化要求在智能体自己先前编写的代码上评估连续的扩展，并检查该功能是否仍然正确。 我们提出 FeatureArc，用于在演化功能上评估编码智能体，并配套一个从仓库历史构建其任务的流水线。 该基准结合了同一功能各连续阶段之间的依赖关系、显式需求与接口契约，以及覆盖四种编程语言的可执行检查。 该流水线在参考代码的每个阶段前后，验证针对新行为的 fail-to-pass（F2P）测试和针对既有行为的 pass-to-pass（P2P）测试。 我们在 73 个经人工审核、包含 2 到 10 个阶段的任务上评估了 10 个编码智能体。 每个智能体在一个持久会话和工作区中工作，没有外部测试反馈，也不能回滚。 评估揭示了首阶段成功与整功能成功之间的差距：汇总成功率从第一阶段的 62.7% 下降到在最终代码上测试整个功能时的 28.5%。 轨迹分析表明，继承缺陷是一种常见的失败机制，出现在 72.9% 的失败后期阶段中。 这些早期错误往往未被察觉：在失败之后的阶段中，智能体约 95% 的情况下没有注意到先前的错误，而且其自测也很少回顾早期阶段。 因此，在没有人工检查介入各阶段的情况下自主演化一个功能，对当前的编码智能体而言仍然是一项重大挑战。 在腾讯，该流水线将内部评估扩展到这一场景，并指导腾讯大语言模型系列 Hunyuan 的研发。

paragraphs.en: Software features evolve as developers extend existing code to meet new requirements [ 1 , 2 ] . We describe this evolution as a sequence of stages , from the initial implementation to successive extensions. Coding agents now inspect repositories, edit code, and run tests autonomously [ 3 , 4 ] . On SWE-bench, which asks agents to resolve individual GitHub issues [ 5 ] , the best model resolved 1.96% at release in 2023; agents now resolve more than 70% of its 500-issue, human-validated Verified subset [ 6 , 7 ] . In 37% of the 13,000 real sessions collected in SWE-chat, agents wrote virtually all committed code [ 8 ] . Developers have also begun delegating successive extensions of a whole feature without intervening checks. Each extension then inherits the agent’s earlier code, including errors the agent has not noticed. We ask: can an agent that implements single requirements well keep a feature correct while extending its own code as requirements evolve?
paragraphs.zh: 软件特性随着开发者在既有代码基础上扩展以满足新需求而不断演化 [ 1 , 2 ] 。 我们将这种演化描述为一系列阶段，从最初的实现到接连不断的扩展。 编码智能体如今能够自主检查代码仓库、编辑代码并运行测试 [ 3 , 4 ] 。 在 SWE-bench（该基准要求智能体解决单个 GitHub 问题 [ 5 ] ）上，最佳模型在 2023 年发布时仅解决了 1.96% 的问题；如今智能体在其经人工验证的 500 题的 Verified 子集上的解决率已超过 70% [ 6 , 7 ] 。 在 SWE-chat 收集的 13,000 个真实会话中，有 37% 的会话里几乎全部已提交代码都由智能体编写 [ 8 ] 。 开发者也开始在不加人工检查的情况下，将一个完整特性的连续扩展任务交给智能体。 于是，每次扩展都会继承智能体先前编写的代码，包括智能体未曾察觉的错误。 我们提出这样的问题：一个能良好实现单一需求的智能体，能否在需求演化、不断扩展自己编写的代码的同时，保持特性的正确性？

paragraphs.en: Evaluating this ability requires agents to sustain a feature while checking their own earlier work. User feedback between stages determines which implementation and verification responsibilities remain with the agent. Similar to the levels of driving automation [ 17 ] and of AI-agent autonomy [ 18 ] , we distinguish four levels of delegation for feature implementation : at L1 the user tells the agent how to fix a failed stage, at L2 the user points out the failing behavior, at L3 the user only says whether a stage passed, and at L4 the user only gives the next specification and says nothing about earlier stages (Figure 1 ). L4 feature implementation requires the agent to find earlier errors itself, whereas at L1–L3 the user reports failed stages. Tencent’s internal multi-stage feature evaluations covered only L1–L3, creating a practical need for L4 evaluation of sustained development. An earlier attempt to build L4 tasks by splitting a single feature request into stages produced weak dependencies: the resulting stages behaved largely as independent single-stage tasks, limiting their ability to test successive extensions. L4 therefore needs stages that depend on each other by construction. We recover these stages from repository histories to capture how developers actually extended a feature to meet new requirements, with each extension building on earlier implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 评估这种能力要求智能体在维持某项功能特性的同时，检查自己先前完成的工作。 各阶段之间的用户反馈决定了哪些实现与验证职责仍由智能体承担。 类似于驾驶自动化等级[17]和AI智能体自主性等级[18]，我们为功能特性实现区分了四个委托等级：L1 时用户告诉智能体如何修复未通过的阶段，L2 时用户指出失败的行为，L3 时用户只说明某个阶段是否通过，L4 时用户只给出下一个规格说明，而对之前的阶段不作任何说明（图1）。 L4 功能特性实现要求智能体自行发现先前的错误，而在 L1–L3 时由用户报告未通过的阶段。 腾讯内部的多阶段功能特性评估仅覆盖 L1–L3，因此对 L4 持续开发评估产生了实际需求。 此前曾尝试通过将单个功能特性请求拆分为多个阶段来构建 L4 任务，但产生的依赖关系较弱：所得到的各阶段在很大程度上表现为相互独立的单阶段任务，限制了它们测试连续扩展的能力。 因此，L4 需要在构造上就相互依赖的阶段。 我们从仓库历史中恢复这些阶段，以刻画开发者实际上如何通过在先前实现的基础上不断扩展功能特性来满足新需求，其中每次扩展都建立在先前的实现之上。

paragraphs.en: Existing feature benchmarks address parts of this setting, but leave a gap in evaluating same-feature evolution from repository histories at L4. As shown in Table I , most pose a single feature request on a fixed starting state [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] , so there is no later stage for an error to affect. Benchmarks with several stages evaluate different development settings: CCBench [ 12 ] gives all stages in one instruction; SWE-STEPS [ 13 ] returns test feedback after each stage and chains pull requests that need not belong to one feature; and SlopCodeBench [ 14 ] , EvoCode-Bench [ 15 ] , and EvoWeb [ 16 ] use stages written by hand or generated from similar products, which do not follow how a feature actually grew in a repository. Among the benchmarks compared in Table I , FeatureArc is the only one that combines historical same-feature dependencies, sequential requests, and continued evaluation on the agent’s own code without hidden-test feedback. Ticks, triangles, and crosses indicate full, partial, and absent support; automated construction covers tasks, environments, and tests, with human review allowed.

paragraphs.en: We address this gap with FeatureArc and an automated pipeline for constructing its tasks. The benchmark has three complementary properties. First, historical same-feature dependencies require agents to extend an existing implementation: the pipeline recovers successive stages of one user-visible feature from repository histories. Second, requirements-grounded verification makes each extension explicit and testable: a requirements document and interface contract specify the expected behavior, while fail-to-pass (F2P) tests and pass-to-pass (P2P) regression tests [ 19 ] check new and existing behavior against reference states. A final check evaluates the complete feature on the agent’s resulting code. Third, diverse repository contexts expose agents to feature evolution in Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Go, across seven application domains. We select the evaluation set through stratified sampling, multi-model trajectory screening for task defects, and manual checks (Section III-F ). At L4, each agent receives specifications sequentially in a persistent session and workspace; hidden-test results are withheld, and the agent carries its own code forward after every stage.

paragraphs.en: The results expose three weaknesses of the evaluated coding agents on evolving-feature tasks. First, whole-feature success is less than half of first-stage success : pooled success falls from 62.7% at the first stage to 28.5% on the whole feature, and even the strongest agent, Claude Opus 5.5 [ 20 ] , completes only 49.3% of the features, although it passes 83.6% of first stages. Second, inherited errors often persist : after a failed stage, agents pass the next stage’s F2P tests in only 22.6% of cases, versus 70.2% after a passed one, whereas breaking earlier behavior affects only 3.3% of features whose new behavior works. Third, agents rarely notice their own earlier failures : in 94.9% of the stages that follow a failed stage, the agent never notices the error. Evolving a feature without human checks between stages therefore remains a substantial challenge for current coding agents.
paragraphs.zh: 评估结果揭示了被评估的编码智能体在演化特性任务上的三个弱点。 首先，整特性成功率不到第一阶段成功的一半：汇总成功率从第一阶段的 62.7% 下降到整特性的 28.5%，即使最强的智能体 Claude Opus 5.5 [20] 也只完成了 49.3% 的特性，尽管它通过了 83.6% 的第一阶段。 其次，继承的错误往往持续存在：在某一阶段失败后，智能体仅在 22.6% 的情况下通过下一阶段的 F2P 测试，而在阶段通过后这一比例为 70.2%；相比之下，破坏早期行为只影响 3.3% 的新行为可正常工作的特性。 第三，智能体很少察觉自己早期的失败：在失败阶段之后的后续阶段中，94.9% 的情况下智能体从未察觉该错误。 因此，在没有人工检查的各阶段之间演化特性，对当前的编码智能体而言仍然是一项重大挑战。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows the L4 evaluation process. One session and workspace persist through the whole task. The agent can inspect its code and run its own checks; reference patches, hidden test suites, and future specifications stay private. When the agent finishes a stage, a hidden acceptance check, called a stage gate , runs its F2P and P2P suites. The stage is the implementation request; the gate checks its result, and both suites must pass for the stage to pass. Failed stages are neither rolled back nor reported to the agent : the next stage starts from the code the agent just produced. After m n − 1 m_{n-1} , a chain gate runs the chain-level F2P and P2P suites on the final workspace to check the complete feature.

As shown in Figure 3 , the pipeline addresses these requirements in five steps: repository collection and history analysis, evolution-chain mining, reference-state construction, environment and test validation, and specification generation. We then select and manually review the evaluation set.

paragraphs.en: To recover meaningful feature evolution, we need histories that contain successive extensions and repositories that can support executable evaluation. As shown in Step 1 of Figure 3 , we select repositories with at least 30 stars, permissive licenses, offline Linux builds, and code written mainly in Python, TypeScript, Rust, or Go. The star threshold provides a basic indication of community interest; the other conditions support redistribution and repeatable execution. Repository histories provide the feature changes and reference implementations used to construct and validate each task. During evaluation, the agent extends its own earlier code, so each new requirement must be implemented against the workspace produced by its preceding edits.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate evolution of one feature, we must distinguish its successive extensions from unrelated changes that happen nearby in time or in the same files. We represent candidate relationships in an evidence graph, illustrated in Step 2 of Figure 3 . Nodes are commits or small commit groups, and edges connect changes through shared code elements, file history, references, or imports. This representation allows the pipeline to follow related changes even when other development occurs between them.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估某个特性的演化，我们必须将其 successive 扩展与时间上邻近或发生在相同文件中的无关变更区分开来。 我们将候选关系表示为一个证据图，如图 3 的步骤 2 所示。 节点是提交或小型提交组，边通过共享的代码元素、文件历史、引用或导入将变更连接起来。 这种表示方式使流水线能够追踪相关变更，即使它们之间发生了其他开发活动。

paragraphs.en: The four searches shown in the figure explore complementary parts of this graph: global beam search follows promising paths, anchor-guided search starts from identified feature changes, endpoint bridging connects related endpoints, and community-guided search examines groups of related changes. An LLM review agent checks the proposed chains against source code, tests, and diffs. A chain is retained only when every stage extends the same user-visible feature with observable, testable behavior. The review also adds missed extensions, removes unrelated work, and adjusts stage boundaries. The output is the mined same-feature chain used to construct the task.
paragraphs.zh: 图中展示的四种搜索探索了该图的不同互补部分：全局束搜索跟随有希望的路径，锚点引导的搜索从已识别的特征变更出发，端点桥接连接相关端点，社区引导的搜索检查相关变更的分组。 一个大语言模型（LLM）评审智能体根据源代码、测试和差异（diff）检查所提出的链条。 只有当链条的每个阶段都以可观察、可测试的行为扩展同一个用户可见特征时，该链条才会被保留。 评审还会补充遗漏的扩展，移除无关的工作，并调整阶段边界。 输出结果是用于构建任务的同特征挖掘链条。

sents.zh: 评审还会补充遗漏的扩展，移除无关的工作，并调整阶段边界。

sents.zh: 输出结果是用于构建任务的同特征挖掘链条。

paragraphs.en: To validate the contribution of each stage, we construct paired reference states that differ by the selected extension while retaining the surrounding repository context. As shown in Step 3 of Figure 3 , we label historical file patches by their role in the feature, its tests, and necessary dependencies, and assign the selected changes to stage patches. We remove these patches from the final checkpoint to obtain the initial state S 0 S_{0} , then reapply them in order to obtain S 1 , … , S n S_{1},\dots,S_{n} . Unselected changes remain as shared context. These paired states let the next step test the contribution of each stage directly.
paragraphs.zh: 为了验证每个阶段的贡献，我们构建成对的参考状态，它们仅在所选扩展上不同，同时保留周围的仓库上下文。 如图3的步骤3所示，我们根据历史文件补丁在特性、其测试以及必要依赖中的角色为其打标签，并将所选变更分配到阶段补丁中。 我们从最终检查点中移除这些补丁以获得初始状态 S 0 S_{0} ，然后按顺序重新应用它们以获得 S 1 , … , S n S_{1},\dots,S_{n} 。 未被选中的变更作为共享上下文保留。 这些成对的状态让下一步能够直接测试每个阶段的贡献。

paragraphs.en: To attribute a failure to the requested behavior, the task must run consistently and its checks must distinguish the code before and after the extension. The environment agent in Step 4 of Figure 3 prepares one offline container image for the chain and repairs it until the reference states build and their tests can be discovered. The test-extraction agent packages historical tests with their required fixtures and helpers, and selects tests according to their observed outcomes on the paired states. F2P tests must fail before the stage and pass afterward; P2P tests must pass on both states. The chain-level suites undergo the same validation between S 0 S_{0} and S n S_{n} , enabling the final check to cover the complete feature across all stages.
paragraphs.zh: 要将失败归因于所请求的行为，任务必须稳定一致地运行，且其检查必须能够区分扩展前后的代码。 图3步骤4中的环境智能体为该链准备一个离线容器镜像，并对其进行修复，直到参考状态能够构建且其测试可被发现。 测试提取智能体将历史测试与其所需的夹具和辅助工具一起打包，并根据测试在配对状态上的观察结果来选择测试。 F2P 测试必须在阶段之前失败并在之后通过；P2P 测试必须在两个状态下都通过。 链级别的测试套件在 S 0 S_{0} 与 S n S_{n} 之间经历同样的验证，使最终检查能够覆盖跨越所有阶段的完整特性。

paragraphs.en: To make the expected behavior accessible without revealing its implementation, each stage needs a behavioral description and an explicit interface contract. As shown in Step 5 of Figure 3 , a specification agent uses the stage patch and F2P tests to write the requirements document and contract. The former states behavior and acceptance criteria; the latter specifies the names, signatures, constants, and error messages needed to use that behavior. Before publication, the pipeline removes registered agent-generated documents and restores documents identified as revealing later implementations to their pre-feature state. The figure’s two output groups reflect this separation: the agent receives initial code, sequential specifications, and the container image, while reference code, hidden tests, and validation records remain private.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在不泄露实现细节的情况下使预期行为可被获取，每个阶段都需要一份行为描述和一份显式的接口契约。 如图 3 的步骤 5 所示，一个规格智能体使用阶段补丁和 F2P 测试来撰写需求文档和契约。 前者陈述行为与验收标准；后者 specifies 使用该行为所需的名称、签名、常量和错误信息。 在发布之前，流水线会移除已登记的智能体生成的文档，并将被认定为泄露后续实现的文档恢复到其功能引入前的状态。 图中的两组输出反映了这种分离：智能体获得初始代码、顺序规格和容器镜像，而参考代码、隐藏测试和验证记录保持私密。

paragraphs.en: Multi-stage evaluation requires repeated model calls and sequential execution within each feature, with costs incurred for every evaluated agent. Given these economic constraints, we select a high-quality subset of the constructed task pool as our evaluation set through three steps.
paragraphs.zh: 多阶段评估需要在每个功能内重复调用模型并顺序执行，每个被评估的智能体都会产生成本。 鉴于这些经济限制，我们通过三个步骤从构建的任务池中选取一个高质量子集作为评估集。

sents.en: Multi-stage evaluation requires repeated model calls and sequential execution within each feature, with costs incurred for every evaluated agent.
sents.zh: 多阶段评估需要在每个功能内重复调用模型并顺序执行，每个被评估的智能体都会产生成本。

sents.en: Given these economic constraints, we select a high-quality subset of the constructed task pool as our evaluation set through three steps.
sents.zh: 鉴于这些经济限制，我们通过三个步骤从构建的任务池中选取一个高质量子集作为评估集。

paragraphs.en: Stratified sampling. To cover different languages and evolution lengths, we sample 100 candidate tasks, 25 per language, stratified by chain length. This retains both short and longer feature-evolution chains in the candidate set. A scan for test-used identifiers missing from the specifications identifies descriptions and contracts that need revision before execution.
paragraphs.zh: 分层抽样。 为了覆盖不同的语言和演化长度，我们抽取 100 个候选任务，每种语言 25 个，并按链长度进行分层。 这样在候选集中既保留了较短的特征演化链，也保留了较长的特征演化链。 扫描测试中用到但规范中缺失的标识符，可以找出在执行前需要修订的描述和契约。

sents.en: Stratified sampling.
sents.zh: 分层抽样。

sents.en: To cover different languages and evolution lengths, we sample 100 candidate tasks, 25 per language, stratified by chain length.
sents.zh: 为了覆盖不同的语言和演化长度，我们抽取 100 个候选任务，每种语言 25 个，并按链长度进行分层。

sents.en: This retains both short and longer feature-evolution chains in the candidate set.
sents.zh: 这样在候选集中既保留了较短的特征演化链，也保留了较长的特征演化链。

sents.zh: 扫描测试中用到但规范中缺失的标识符，可以找出在执行前需要修订的描述和契约。

paragraphs.en: Task-defect exclusion. To identify task defects, we run candidate tasks with several models and inspect their execution trajectories. We check these trajectories against the specifications, hidden tests, and reference implementations to distinguish task defects from agent errors. This screening excludes seven tasks: five whose chain-level suites require unspecified behavior, one with a defective test suite, and one with a repository hook that intercepts the prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 任务缺陷排除。 为了识别任务缺陷，我们使用多个模型运行候选任务并检查其执行轨迹。 我们将这些轨迹与规范、隐藏测试和参考实现进行比对，以区分任务缺陷与智能体错误。 这一筛查排除了七个任务：五个任务其链级测试套件要求未规定的行为，一个任务的测试套件存在缺陷，还有一个任务的仓库钩子拦截了提示词。

sents.en: Task-defect exclusion.
sents.zh: 任务缺陷排除。

sents.en: To identify task defects, we run candidate tasks with several models and inspect their execution trajectories.
sents.zh: 为了识别任务缺陷，我们使用多个模型运行候选任务并检查其执行轨迹。

sents.en: We check these trajectories against the specifications, hidden tests, and reference implementations to distinguish task defects from agent errors.
sents.zh: 我们将这些轨迹与规范、隐藏测试和参考实现进行比对，以区分任务缺陷与智能体错误。

sents.en: This screening excludes seven tasks: five whose chain-level suites require unspecified behavior, one with a defective test suite, and one with a repository hook that intercepts the prompt.
sents.zh: 这一筛查排除了七个任务：五个任务其链级测试套件要求未规定的行为，一个任务的测试套件存在缺陷，还有一个任务的仓库钩子拦截了提示词。

paragraphs.en: Manual check. To ensure that the selected tasks measure the intended feature-evolution setting, we manually check them for specification quality, alignment between interface contracts and hidden tests, and whether successive stages extend the same feature. The resulting FeatureArc evaluation set contains 73 tasks with 263 stages from 53 repositories . All reported agent comparisons use this same set.
paragraphs.zh: 人工检查。 为确保所选任务能够衡量预期的功能演化场景，我们对其进行了人工检查，包括规格质量、接口契约与隐藏测试之间的一致性，以及各后续阶段是否扩展同一功能。 最终得到的 FeatureArc 评测集包含来自 53 个代码仓库的 73 个任务和 263 个阶段。 所有报告的智能体对比均使用这同一评测集。

sents.en: Manual check.
sents.zh: 人工检查。

paragraphs.en: Historical same-feature dependencies. Later stages require agents to revisit earlier work, making inherited implementation decisions part of the task. paragraphs.en: Agent execution and comparability. Nine evaluated agents run in Claude Code, 1 1 1 Claude Code: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview . while GPT-6 Astra uses the native Codex CLI. 2 2 2 Codex CLI: https://github.com/openai/codex . For GPT-6 Astra, Codex preserves the native tool-call representation and session-resumption mechanism, avoiding the additional adaptation required to run it through Claude Code. paragraphs.en: Trajectory annotation. Hunyuan 4 Preview, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and GLM-5.3 Flash [ 24 ] independently annotate the trajectories using a shared codebook, following the LLM-as-judge approach [ 34 ] . They assign process labels before accessing gate logs, hidden tests, and reference patches for diagnosis, and cite trajectory evidence for every label. paragraphs.en: We adopt the following metrics; table abbreviations appear in parentheses.

paragraphs.en: Single-stage pass rate m 0 m_{0} : the fraction of tasks whose first stage passes both F2P and P2P, starting from the initial state S 0 S_{0} .

paragraphs.en: Chain-gate pass rate (Gate): the fraction of tasks whose chain gate passes on the final workspace.
paragraphs.zh: 链门通过率（Gate）：在最终工作区上链门通过的任务比例。

paragraphs.en: Continuation rate (Cont.): the stage pass rate at m 1 m_{1} and later, conditioned on all earlier stages of that chain having passed.
paragraphs.zh: 续写率（Cont.）：在 m 1 m_{1} 及之后各阶段的通过率，条件是该链条中所有更早的阶段均已通过。

paragraphs.en: Stage F2P rate (F2P): the fraction of evaluated stages whose F2P suite passes.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 F2P 通过率（F2P）：所评估阶段中 F2P 测试套件通过的比例。

paragraphs.en: Prefix depth (Depth): the number of consecutive passed stages before the first failure, divided by chain length.
paragraphs.zh: 前缀深度（Depth）：首次失败之前连续通过的阶段数，除以链长度。

paragraphs.en: Survival at m k m_{k} : the fraction of tasks with more than k k stages whose stages m 0 . . m k m_{0}..m_{k} all pass.
paragraphs.zh: 在 m k m_{k} 处的存活率：在超过 k k 个阶段的任务中，其阶段 m 0 . . m k m_{0}..m_{k} 全部通过的任务所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: Chain-level P2P failure (P2P ↓ \downarrow ): the fraction of tasks whose chain-level P2P suite fails.
paragraphs.zh: 链级 P2P 失败（P2P ↓ \downarrow ）：链级 P2P 测试套件失败的任务所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: In-chain regression rate: among runs in which every stage passed F2P at completion, the fraction whose final workspace fails chain-level F2P.
paragraphs.zh: 链内回归率：在所有阶段完成时均通过 F2P 的运行中，最终工作区未能通过链级 F2P 的比例。

paragraphs.en: Pure regression rate: among runs whose final workspace passes chain-level F2P, the fraction that fail chain-level P2P.
paragraphs.zh: 纯回归率：在最终工作区通过链级 F2P 的运行中，未能通过链级 P2P 的比例。

paragraphs.en: Finding 3: Most runs break in the first two stages, and long tasks rarely succeed. Figure 6 a shows where runs that never recover first fail. paragraphs.en: To explain failures beyond the first stage, we examine whether later stages build on correct behavior or inherit unresolved defects. Figure 7 compares next-stage success after passed and failed stages, and Table IV reports the trajectory evidence. The agents revisit earlier code to a similar extent as the reference implementations: 52.8%–57.7% of their later-stage changed files were changed earlier, consistent with the dependence shown in Figure 4 d. This establishes the setting in which an earlier implementation error can affect a later request.

paragraphs.en: Finding 4: Inherited defects are common in failed later stages. Next-stage F2P success falls from 70.2% after a passed stage to 22.6% after a failed stage (Figure 7 ). The gap appears for every agent. Using the comparison within each task and stage defined in Section IV-D , we retain 109 task-stage groups containing both prior-stage outcomes. The gap remains when task-stage groups receive equal weight: the averaged within-group F2P pass rates are 72.6% after a passed stage and 29.0% after a failed stage. Once a run fails a stage, on average 85.1% of its remaining stages fail as well. The inheritance column of Table IV connects this performance gap to concrete defects: 72.9% of failed later stages involve errors left in earlier stages, with those defects accounting for the failure wholly in 47.1% and partly in 25.9%.

paragraphs.en: We also examine how stage position and context relate to success in later stages. Among runs in which all earlier stages passed, the stage-gate pass rates at m 1 m_{1} , m 2 m_{2} , and m 3 + m_{3+} range from 66.6% to 77.7%, with no downward trend. For later stages with available context measurements, the F2P gap between stages with and without detected context compaction is 6.2 percentage points for stages with fewer than 40 tool calls and 5.2 points for those with 40–99 tool calls. Among later stages with fully passed prefixes, F2P success is 75.0% when the cumulative specifications contain 1,500–2,999 words and 68.6% when they contain at least 8,000 words, a difference of 6.4 points. These gaps are smaller than the 47.6-point gap associated with the previous stage’s outcome.

paragraphs.en: Finding 5: Regression is uncommon after stages pass their tests. Regression, in which later edits break behavior that already worked, is the other way a chain can fail. We measure it in two ways. In-chain regression : every stage passed its own F2P suite, yet the final workspace fails the chain-level F2P suite; it occurs in 7.3% of the runs in which every stage passed F2P. Pure regression : the final workspace passes chain-level F2P but fails chain-level P2P; it occurs in 3.3% of the runs whose final workspace passes chain-level F2P. Inherited defects fail at least one later stage in 52.9% of feature runs, consistent with the inheritance evidence in Table IV . Runs that establish the required behavior usually retain it through the final check. The higher P2P failure rates in Table III (5.5%–20.5%) also include runs whose new feature behavior fails; they answer a broader question than pure regression.
paragraphs.zh: 发现 5：各阶段通过测试后，回归并不常见。 回归指后续修改破坏了原本已经正常工作的行为，是链式流程失败的另一种方式。 我们用两种方式来度量它。 链内回归：每个阶段都通过了各自的 F2P 测试集，但最终工作区却未通过链级 F2P 测试集；这种情况发生在所有阶段均通过 F2P 的运行中的 7.3%。 纯回归：最终工作区通过了链级 F2P，却未通过链级 P2P；这种情况发生在最终工作区通过链级 F2P 的运行中的 3.3%。 在 52.9% 的功能运行中，继承而来的缺陷至少会使一个后续阶段失败，这与表 IV 中的继承证据一致。 建立了所需行为的运行通常能在最终检查中保持该行为。 表 III 中较高的 P2P 失败率（5.5%–20.5%）还包括新功能行为失败的运行；它们回答的问题比纯回归更为宽泛。

paragraphs.en: Finding 7: A green self-test barely predicts the hidden F2P result, and a red one is usually dismissed. Overall, 73.8% of stages end on a green self-test, yet only 52.7% of these pass F2P, barely above the 50.4% rate over all stages; stages that end red still pass in 45.2% (Table IV ). Using the same comparison procedure, the mean within-group F2P pass rates are 52.9% for green final self-tests and 47.9% for red final self-tests across 161 task-stage groups containing both outcomes. As Figure 8 shows, the self-test is least reliable right after a failed stage: of the 713 stages that still end on a green self-test, only 24.5% pass F2P. The share of false greens, green self-tests whose stage fails F2P, rises from 28.7% after a passed stage to 75.5% after a failed one.

paragraphs.en: Connecting observed usage to internal evaluation. In an internal corpus of 8,881 IDE episodes at Tencent, 3,797 of the 8,728 episodes with valid user turns (43.5%) contained follow-up interaction. Model-based annotations of the first follow-up identified constraint additions (30.1%), requirement clarifications (19.7%), and functionality extensions (17.9%). The observed extensions motivate evaluating continued feature development. To reduce user checking between extensions, agents must detect defects in their own earlier code. Tencent’s existing L1–L3 evaluations supply failure feedback, leaving this unaided detection ability untested. We therefore use our pipeline and FeatureArc to assess Hunyuan 4 Preview alongside external agents at L4: users supply successive requirements, while earlier failures are not reported to the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 将观测到的使用情况与内部评估相连接。 在腾讯内部包含 8,881 个 IDE 会话记录的语料库中，8,728 个具有有效用户轮次的会话记录里有 3,797 个（43.5%）包含后续交互。 基于模型对首次后续交互的标注识别出约束新增（30.1%）、需求澄清（19.7%）和功能扩展（17.9%）。 观测到的功能扩展促使我们评估持续的功能开发。 为了减少用户在扩展之间的检查，智能体必须能够检测出自己早期代码中的缺陷。 腾讯现有的 L1–L3 评估提供了失败反馈，因此这种无辅助的自主检测能力尚未得到测试。 因此，我们使用我们的流水线和 FeatureArc，在 L4 层级将 Hunyuan 4 Preview 与外部智能体进行对比评估：用户提供连续的需求，而先前的失败不会报告给智能体。

sents.en: To reduce user checking between extensions, agents must detect defects in their own earlier code.

sents.en: We therefore use our pipeline and FeatureArc to assess Hunyuan 4 Preview alongside external agents at L4: users supply successive requirements, while earlier failures are not reported to the agent.
sents.zh: 因此，我们使用我们的流水线和 FeatureArc，在 L4 层级将 Hunyuan 4 Preview 与外部智能体进行对比评估：用户提供连续的需求，而先前的失败不会报告给智能体。

paragraphs.en: Diagnosing development needs beyond the first-stage score. Table III shows that Hunyuan 4 Preview passes 60.3% of first stages but completes 34.2% of whole features (95% interval 23.3%–45.2%). Its 75.0% continuation rate indicates that it can often extend a feature when its earlier stages are correct. Figure 7 reveals a different situation after an error: next-stage F2P success falls from 71.6% after a passed stage to 22.5% after a failed one. The prior-awareness evidence in Table IV helps explain this gap: Hunyuan leaves 90.2% of earlier failures unnoticed. This is the lowest missed-failure rate among the evaluated agents; most earlier errors still persist unrecognized during subsequent feature development.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一阶段得分之外诊断开发需求。 表 III 显示，Hunyuan 4 Preview 通过了 60.3% 的第一阶段，但只完成了 34.2% 的完整功能（95% 区间为 23.3%–45.2%）。 其 75.0% 的延续率表明，当早期阶段正确时，它通常能够继续扩展一个功能。 图 7 揭示了出错后的不同情形：下一阶段的 F2P 成功率从通过上一阶段后的 71.6% 降至失败后的 22.5%。 表 IV 中关于先验感知的证据有助于解释这一差距：Hunyuan 对 90.2% 的早期失败未能察觉。 这是被评估的智能体中最低的漏检失败率；大多数早期错误在后续功能开发中仍然未被识别而持续存在。

paragraphs.en: Turning evaluation evidence into development priorities. The pipeline links unsuccessful runs to specifications, code changes, and checks, helping the Hunyuan team distinguish failures to implement new behavior from failures to recognize inherited defects. For example, Hunyuan attributes a final failing self-test to unrelated or pre-existing causes in 44 of 46 stages, but checks that explanation against the starting code in only 5 of those 44 cases. This evidence gives the Hunyuan team concrete failure cases for improving checks of earlier requirements and verification of failure explanations. These capabilities are necessary for supporting continued feature development when users leave intermediate validation to the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 将评估证据转化为开发优先级。 该流水线将失败的运行与规格说明、代码变更和检查关联起来，帮助混元团队区分「未能实现新行为」的失败与「未能识别继承缺陷」的失败。 例如，在 46 个阶段中，混元将其中 44 个阶段的最终自测失败归因于无关或先前存在的原因，但在 44 个案例中只有 5 个会对照起始代码验证这一解释。 这一证据为混元团队提供了具体的失败案例，用于改进对早期需求的检查以及对失败解释的验证。 当用户把中间验证留给智能体时，这些能力对于支持持续的功能开发是必不可少的。

paragraphs.en: FeatureArc may not cover the full range of workflows encountered in real-world feature development. To broaden coverage, it includes four widely used programming languages—Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Go—and seven application domains, with tasks stratified by language and chain length (Figure 4 ). This breadth, together with tasks mined from repository histories, helps the benchmark reflect agents’ performance on evolving requirements across practical development settings.
paragraphs.zh: FeatureArc 可能无法覆盖现实世界功能开发中遇到的全部工作流程。 为了扩大覆盖范围，它包含四种广泛使用的编程语言——Python、TypeScript、Rust 和 Go——以及七个应用领域，任务按语言和链长度进行分层（图 4）。 这种广度，加上从仓库历史中挖掘的任务，有助于该基准反映智能体在真实开发环境中应对不断变化需求的表现。

paragraphs.en: Feature and interactive benchmarks. Single-request benchmarks evaluate feature implementation on fixed codebases [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] . Multi-stage feature [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 16 ] and sequential-development benchmarks [ 38 , 39 , 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 ] extend evaluation across development stages, with different stage sources, feature scope, and feedback. EvoCode-Bench allows four attempts that stop at the first failure and compares with reference-code starts [ 15 ] . Interactive benchmarks add responsive users [ 44 , 45 ] , incremental requirements [ 46 , 47 ] , or clarification [ 48 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 功能与交互式基准测试。 单请求基准测试在固定代码库上评估功能实现 [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] 。 多阶段功能基准测试 [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 16 ] 和顺序开发基准测试 [ 38 , 39 , 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 ] 将评估扩展到多个开发阶段，其阶段来源、功能范围和反馈各不相同。 EvoCode-Bench 允许四次尝试并在首次失败时停止，并与从参考代码开始的情况进行比较 [ 15 ] 。 交互式基准测试引入了可响应的用户 [ 44 , 45 ] 、增量式需求 [ 46 , 47 ] 或澄清环节 [ 48 ] 。

paragraphs.en: FeatureArc differs by combining historical same-feature dependencies with continued evaluation on the agent’s own code without intermediate failure feedback (Table I ). Validated stage and whole-feature checks measure correctness across extensions, while trajectory analysis examines the persistence and detection of inherited errors.

paragraphs.en: We presented FeatureArc together with a pipeline that constructs its executable feature-evolution tasks from repository histories. The benchmark combines historical same-feature dependencies, requirements-grounded verification, and diverse repository contexts to evaluate agents that extend their own code without external acceptance feedback. Our study reveals a substantial gap between first-stage implementation and whole-feature completion: pooled success falls from 62.7% to 28.5%. Inherited defects are common in failed later stages, and agents rarely notice these errors or expose them through self-tests. At Tencent, the pipeline extends internal evaluation to L4 and provides evidence about Hunyuan’s ability to recognize and recover from errors during feature development. FeatureArc supports further study of sustained feature correctness as requirements evolve, using dependent stages and executable checks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 FeatureArc，并配套一个流水线，可从仓库历史中构建其可执行的特征演化任务。 该基准结合了历史上的同特征依赖、基于需求文档的验证以及多样化的仓库环境，用于评估那些在没有外部验收反馈的情况下扩展自身代码的智能体。 我们的研究揭示了第一阶段实现与整个特征完成之间的显著差距：汇总成功率从 62.7% 下降到 28.5%。 继承的缺陷在失败的后续阶段中很常见，而智能体很少察觉这些错误，也很少通过自测将其暴露出来。 在腾讯，该流水线将内部评估扩展到了 L4，并为混元在特征开发过程中识别错误和从错误中恢复的能力提供了证据。 FeatureArc 支持在需求不断演进的情况下，利用依赖阶段和可执行检查，对持续的 Feature 正确性开展进一步研究。
